name: @countly/kafkajs
description: KafkaJS-compatible, pure-JS Apache Kafka client for Kafka 4.0+ and Node.js 22+ (Countly-maintained fork of kafkajs)
author: Tulio Ornelas <ornelas.tulio@gmail.com>

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run compat:check && npm run protocol:check && npm run test:kafka -- "jest --ci --maxWorkers=4 --forceExit"
scripts.test:group:oauthbearer: OAUTHBEARER_ENABLED=1 jest --forceExit src/producer/index.spec.js src/broker/__tests__/connect.spec.js src/consumer/__tests__/connection.spec.js src/broker/__tests__/disconnect.spec.js src/admin/__tests__/connection.spec.js src/broker/__tests__/reauthenticate.spec.js
scripts.test:e2e:idempotent-authz: COMPOSE_FILE=docker-compose.acl.yml npm run test:kafka -- "IDEMPOTENT_AUTHZ_E2E=1 npx jest --forceExit --runInBand --testPathPatterns 'src/producer/__tests__/idempotentAuthzLive\\.spec\\.js'"
scripts.test:e2e:otel: OTEL_E2E=1 npm run test:kafka -- "npm run test:otel"
scripts.test:e2e:rack-aware: COMPOSE_FILE=docker-compose.racks.yml npm run test:kafka -- "RACK_AWARE_E2E=1 npx jest --maxWorkers=2 --testPathPatterns 'src/consumer/__tests__/rackAwareLive\\.spec\\.js'"
scripts.test:e2e:fetch-sessions: COMPOSE_FILE=docker-compose.racks.yml npm run test:kafka -- "FETCH_SESSIONS_E2E=1 npx jest --maxWorkers=2 --testPathPatterns 'src/consumer/__tests__/fetchSessionsLive\\.spec\\.js'"
scripts.test:e2e:gssapi: timeout -k 20s 600s node "${P9_CLUSTER_GUARD:?set P9_CLUSTER_GUARD to the reviewed guard}" 4.3.1 kerberos GSSAPI_E2E src/broker/__tests__/gssapiLive.spec.js
scripts.test:e2e:tls-negative: timeout --kill-after=10s 1800s node "${P9_CLUSTER_GUARD:?set P9_CLUSTER_GUARD to the reviewed guard}" 4.3.1 tls-required TLS_NEGATIVE_E2E src/network/__tests__/tlsNegativeLive.spec.js
scripts.test:e2e:delete-groups-v3: timeout -k 20s 600s node "${P9_CLUSTER_GUARD:?set P9_CLUSTER_GUARD to the reviewed guard}" ${KAFKA_VERSION:-4.3.1} tv2 DELETE_GROUPS_V3_E2E src/admin/__tests__/deleteGroupsV3Live.spec.js
scripts.test:e2e:rack-aware-producer: timeout -k 20s 600s node "${P9_CLUSTER_GUARD:?set P9_CLUSTER_GUARD to the reviewed guard}" ${KAFKA_VERSION:-4.3.1} racks RACK_AWARE_PRODUCER_E2E src/producer/__tests__/rackAwareProducerLive.spec.js
scripts.test:e2e:api-identity: timeout -k 20s 600s node "${P9_CLUSTER_GUARD:?set P9_CLUSTER_GUARD to the reviewed guard}" ${KAFKA_VERSION:-4.3.1} tv2 API_IDENTITY_E2E src/broker/__tests__/apiVersionsIdentityLive.spec.js
